clue.text: A job in the kitchen getting wet clothes on the rack?

definitions.meaning: cleaning the plates, pans and cutlery after a meal is a familiar kitchen chore
laundry that has been washed and hung up to dry on a rack or line

explanation.surface: Someone in the kitchen ends up drenched while hanging out the laundry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting' is only a link between the two senses; the question mark flags the punning second reading.
explanation.definitionFit: A double definition: the chore of cleaning dishes, and laundry literally hung up after a wash.

clue.text: Piece of bread and water, fine for tit initially

indicators.note: fine for tit means the one letter replaces the other

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: initially means just the first letter of tit is taken

parts.note: F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: A meagre meal of bread and water, with a bird mentioned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' is a link; F replaces T, the first letter of 'tit', in WATER.
explanation.definitionFit: A communion wafer is the thin piece of bread used in church.

clue.text: PM shot — awful creep claps? Never!

indicators.note: awful suggests the words are a mess and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone disgusted that a dreadful sycophant would ever applaud a prime minister.
explanation.walkthrough: Spencer Perceval is the only British prime minister assassinated, shot in the House of Commons lobby in 1812.
explanation.definitionFit: Perceval was the British prime minister shot dead in 1812, so he is the PM shot.

clue.text: How quickly your clean driving record may be lost?

definitions.text: How quickly your clean driving record may be lost?

parts.words: How quickly your clean driving record may be lost?
parts.note: a speed camera's flash catches a speeding driver instantly, so the phrase for instantly fits both

explanation.surface: Musing on how fast a spotless licence can be ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for instantly, and literally a camera's flash records speeding.

clue.text: Cut good wood

parts.note: ash is a type of wood

explanation.surface: An instruction to chop decent timber.
explanation.definitionFit: A gash is a deep cut or wound.

clue.text: Cricketer, first to purchase excellent hat

indicators.note: first to means only the opening letter of purchase is used

parts.note: ace is slang for excellent
a bowler is a hard round hat

explanation.surface: A cricketer is the first to buy a fine hat.
explanation.walkthrough: A bowler hat is the British round felt hat; in cricket a bowler delivers the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: A fast bowler is a type of cricketer who delivers the ball at speed.

clue.text: Bugs seen round a sort of Spanish bar

indicators.note: seen round means the listening devices are placed around the next letter

parts.note: to bug a phone is to tap it, so bugs are taps

explanation.surface: Hidden microphones have been found around a bar in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: A tapas bar is a Spanish bar serving small snacks, so the word names that sort of bar.

clue.text: Extremely distressing, doughboy in vehicle that's flipped over

indicators.note: in means the soldier is placed inside the vehicle
flipped over means the vehicle's word is read backwards

parts.note: a cart is a vehicle
doughboy is old slang for an American soldier, a GI

explanation.surface: A soldier trapped in an overturned vehicle is a dreadful sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's flipped over' turns CART into TRAC, which holds GI.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tragic is deeply sad or calamitous, so extremely distressing.

clue.text: Go on a pub crawl, to get rid of the blues?

definitions.meaning: to go out celebrating and drinking in a lively way
whimsically, recolouring a whole town from blue to red

explanation.surface: Advice to cheer yourself up by going out drinking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link; the question mark marks the punning second sense, where blue meaning sad is literally painted over.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means going out for a wild night of drinking and fun.

clue.text: Condemned in a few words put together by Democrat?

parts.note: a sentence is a group of words assembled

explanation.surface: A Democrat briefly condemns something in a short statement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' just places D beside the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A condemned prisoner has been sentenced by a court.

clue.text: Trick cyclist's technique unaffected by partnership

parts.note: free of, untouched by something, as in tax-free
an association is a union or partnership

explanation.surface: A stunt cyclist's riding method owes nothing to working with anyone else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trick cyclist' is old British slang for a psychiatrist (rhyming loosely with psychiatrist), not a circus performer.
explanation.definitionFit: Letting the patient say whatever comes to mind is a classic psychoanalytic technique.

clue.text: Remember to cancel

definitions.meaning: to revoke or withdraw, as a faulty product is called back

explanation.surface: A note to oneself not to forget to cancel something.
explanation.definitionFit: A double definition: bring back to memory, and withdraw or revoke an order or product.

clue.text: Article on a bishop's vice drink

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece written on another comes after it

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
a vice is a sin
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece exposes a bishop's weakness for drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A green aniseed-flavoured spirit is a strong alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Preparations to build stadium?

definitions.meaning: basic preliminary work done before a project
playfully, construction work on a sports ground

explanation.surface: Getting ready to put up a sports arena.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link; a ground is a sports stadium, so groundwork can mean building one.
explanation.definitionFit: A double definition: preliminary preparation, and literally work on a sports ground.

clue.text: Treacherous rocks confronting rowing teams — these'll help those who've got in the drink

definitions.text: these'll help those who've got in the drink

indicators.note: treacherous suggests the rocks are not what they seem, so their letters are rearranged

parts.note: crews are rowing teams

explanation.surface: Rowers face dangerous rocks, and something will rescue those who fall into the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Treacherous' rearranges ROCKS into CORKS; 'confronting' only places it first. 'In the drink' looks like fallen into the water, but here means having bought a bottle to open.
explanation.definitionFit: Tools for drawing corks help anyone who has bought wine to open it.

clue.text: Fellow worker in company left union

parts.note: a league is a union or alliance

explanation.surface: A co-worker in the firm has quit the trade union.
explanation.definitionFit: A colleague is someone one works alongside.

clue.text: Stylish young woman? No end

indicators.note: no end tells us the final letter of the word for a girl is dropped

parts.note: chick is slang for a young woman

explanation.surface: Asking whether a fashionable girl is endlessly so.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic is a borrowed French word for elegant and fashionable.

clue.text: A curt one dancing a dance

indicators.note: dancing suggests the letters move about into a new order

explanation.surface: A brusque person is dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: A courante is a Baroque dance in triple time.

clue.text: One inside conducted a piece of music

indicators.note: inside means the numeral goes within the word for conducted

parts.note: led means guided or conducted
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone within an orchestra led a performance of a work.
explanation.definitionFit: A Lied is a German art song, a piece of music for voice and piano.

clue.text: Confident, refuse to do broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters are strewn into a new order

explanation.surface: A self-assured person declines to go on air.
explanation.definitionFit: Being steady on one's feet extends figuratively to being sure and confident.

clue.text: The sort of drink to give one courage?

definitions.text: The sort of drink to give one courage?

parts.words: The sort of drink to give one courage?
parts.note: strong liquor provides Dutch courage, and the word also means courage itself

explanation.surface: Asking what kind of drink would make someone brave.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirits are strong alcoholic drinks, and spirit also means mettle or courage.

clue.text: Get away, carrying diamonds after a stunt

indicators.note: carrying means the escape word holds the other letters within it

parts.note: to escape is to get away

indicators.note: the diamonds letter is placed after the article

parts.note: D is the card-suit abbreviation for diamonds

explanation.surface: A thief flees with jewels after some daring act.
explanation.definitionFit: An escapade is a daring or reckless adventure, much like a stunt.

clue.text: Mature wife is in band

indicators.note: is in means the abbreviation sits inside the word for band

parts.note: a group is a musical band

explanation.surface: A grown-up woman plays in a band with her husband.
explanation.definitionFit: To mature is to become adult, the phrasal verb for growing older.

clue.text: Vitality plus unusual energy

indicators.note: unusual means the letters appear in an unexpected order

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Liveliness plus unusual energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Pulse can mean the rhythm of life, a sense of vitality or energy.

clue.text: Fruit of unpleasant appearance, so they say

indicators.note: so they say signals that the word is as heard when spoken

parts.note: ugly means unpleasant to look at

explanation.surface: A fruit said to look unpleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: An ugli is a Jamaican citrus fruit, a tangelo with wrinkled skin.

clue.text: Army officer follows father as acting head of state

indicators.note: follows puts the army rank after the word for father

parts.note: governor is old slang for one's father, the guv'nor
a general is a senior army officer

explanation.surface: A soldier follows in his father's footsteps to become acting head of state.
explanation.definitionFit: In Commonwealth realms this official represents the monarch, standing in as head of state.

clue.text: Backed story about one Israeli port

indicators.note: about means the backwards word goes round the numeral
backed means the word for story is read from right to left

parts.note: a tale is a story
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone supported a tale about an Israeli port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Backed' turns TALE into ELAT, which goes round I.
explanation.definitionFit: Eilat is Israel's southern port, on the Gulf of Aqaba.

clue.text: Charge packed into keg in front of Dail, possibly causing such a critical situation

indicators.note: packed into means the charge is stuffed inside the other letters
possibly signals that the letters could be arranged another way
front of means only the first letter of the Irish parliament's name is used

parts.note: a fee is a charge

explanation.surface: A keg packed with explosive sits outside Ireland's parliament, threatening a crisis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges KEG IN plus D (front of Dáil) into KNIDGE, and 'packed into' puts FEE inside it. The Dáil is the Irish lower house.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on a blade's sharp edge is the idiom for a finely balanced, precarious situation.
